stages.name: A Home on the Frontier
stages.unlock: Establish shelter, food storage, and a safe route from spawn.
stages.balance: Keep starter gear useful; avoid rushing boss dimensions before basic armor and food are ready.

stages.name: The First Arts
stages.unlock: Explore and gather spell materials before taking on major bosses.
stages.balance: Treat spell progression as a parallel route, not a replacement for exploration and ordinary equipment.

stages.name: Awakening
stages.unlock: Pursue ability and firearm paths through their own materials and encounters.
stages.balance: Choose encounter-appropriate loadouts; scarce ammunition and ability resources keep both paths meaningful.

stages.name: Beyond the Familiar
stages.unlock: Use mapped exploration and staged gear upgrades to tackle dimension landmarks.
stages.balance: Do not skip dimension milestones with high-tier loot from another route.

stages.name: Cataclysmic Frontiers
stages.unlock: Challenge boss arenas with upgraded armor, a planned role/loadout, and recovery supplies.
stages.balance: Bosses are milestones; distribute rewards across the magic, ranged, and melee playstyles.

stages.name: The Deep Beyond
stages.unlock: Enter the late-game dimension after completing earlier exploration and boss objectives.
stages.balance: Keep unique late-game materials gated to their intended dimension and encounters.

stages.name: Endless Mastery
stages.unlock: Complete optional challenges, seek rare gear, and refine alternate builds.
stages.balance: Treat uncapped enchantment systems as optional endgame progression; tune costs and limits after testing.
